explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who only frequent bars serving beers they like (no bar serves a beer they dislike). Q2 selects drinkers who both have at least one liked beer served at a frequented bar AND at least one liked beer not served at any frequented bar. These are distinct conditions.
counterexample_dsp: A drinker (Bob) who likes two beers (A and B) and frequents a single bar (BarX) serving both beers. Q1 returns Bob (all served beers are liked). Q2 returns nothing (no liked beer is unserved at any frequented bar).
